name: @insumermodel/plugin-eliza
description: ElizaOS plugin for InsumerAPI: condition-based access for autonomous agents. 10 actions: buy API key, create merchant, configure conditions, add credits, verify wallets, trust profiles (155 base checks across 27 chains in 10 dimensions, up to 176 across 29 chains in 14 with optional Solana, XRPL, Bitcoin and Tron wallets; Stellar and Sui wallets switch on rows inside the base dimensions), ACP/UCP commerce, confirm payments. ECDSA-signed results across 37 blockchains.
author: Insumer Model <contact@insumermodel.com>
